title: 骚扰电话太多，怎么屏蔽？
summary: 天天接到骚扰电话：问运营商开拦截、手机设置勿扰，英语这样说。

phrases.en: Can you block spam calls for me?
phrases.zh: 能帮我拦截骚扰电话吗？

phrases.en: How do I block a number?

phrases.zh: 我忘了语音留言的密码。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, I keep getting spam calls every day.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我每天都接到骚扰电话。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. We have a free spam blocking feature. Want me to turn it on?
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，我们有免费的骚扰拦截功能，要帮你打开吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, please. How do I block a number on my phone?
dialogue.zh: 要，怎么在手机上拉黑号码？

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Open the recent calls, tap the number, then Block.
dialogue.zh: 打开通话记录，点那个号码，再点拉黑。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Got it. By the way, I forgot my voicemail password.
dialogue.zh: 会了，顺便问下，我忘了语音留言的密码。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: No problem, I've reset it for you.
dialogue.zh: 没问题，已经帮你重置了。

seoTitle: 美国骚扰电话太多怎么办？屏蔽英语说法
seoDescription: 骚扰电话太多：让运营商开拦截、手机拉黑号码的英语说法，附真实对话。
